findings.label: Raw head is unescaped (trust boundary)
findings.detail: assets.head strings are injected verbatim into <head>, including any <script>/<style> an author places there, which can bypass the 'author JS after glue' and 'no blocking head script' guarantees. Intended author-trusted escape hatch, documented in agent-reference, architecture, and human-guide. Keep it author-only; never wire untrusted input into it. No change required.

findings.label: Check-path assertion is non-discriminating
findings.detail: test/site-config.test.ts:134-140 only asserts that a page which is valid without site configuration does not throw, so the test would still pass if checkPage stopped forwarding sitePath. Assert a site-only observable, such as a site-labeled error from a deliberately malformed temporary config.
